summary: Meta AI announces the beta release of Muse Code, described as its first coding agent that coordinates multiple persistent subagents, alongside a new model version, Muse Spark 1.2.

mechanisms.reason: The post describes a coding agent that coordinates multiple persistent subagents to complete engineering tasks with less human intervention, describing a shift from single-call assistance to autonomous multi-agent task execution.
mechanisms.quote: Muse Code is our first coding agent — it coordinates multiple persistent subagents to complete complex engineering tasks faster, more accurately, and with less intervention.

practices.reason: The post gestures at a multi-subagent coordination architecture for coding tasks but gives no implementation detail or measured gain, so it is not yet reproducible.
